responsibility: Provides the C-side companion definitions for the ISO channel open-result enumeration so C runtime components can interoperate with Modula-2 device modules. Its enum values are required to match ChanConsts.def exactly, making it a small ABI bridge used by non-Modula-2 support code that reports channel-open outcomes back into the gm2 I/O framework.
same_name_distinction: This same-stem file is the C header bridge, not a Modula-2 module: it mirrors the OpenResults enumeration so C runtime code can share the exact ABI values from ChanConsts.def, whereas ChanConsts.mod contains no substantive implementation.
